fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled access road off Highway 114; chain-link perimeter fencing visible all around the campus in Street View (Oct 2025); GP welcome monument sign at the road junction; rail crossing en route to the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No frontal booth view obtained in Street View, but a fully-fenced 1000+ employee mill with a single controlled access road runs a staffed gatehouse by standard; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large distribution warehouse with continuous dock-door banks along both ~750m long faces, plus dock banks on process/converting buildings; clearly 50+, estimated ~70.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked along the warehouse aprons and adjacent lots; bounded by ponds and rail so dedicated stalls are moderate, 10-25 band, ~90 trailers visible total.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks run on both long faces of the warehouse and on separate process-side buildings, implying physically separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail spur and rail yard run through the property; box cars and tank cars visible in Street View and satellite.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building campus: pulp/paper process buildings, paper machines, converting, a ~750m distribution warehouse, power plant, plus extensive settling-pond complex to the SE.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable near the gate; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box covers the fenced developed industrial footprint; excludes the large SE settling-pond complex which is not truck yard.
